method.sourceEvidence: Independent direct reading of each of the four actual plain page PNGs against every frozen page.md/page.json block: prose, printed line breaks, headings, bold spans, readable formula glyphs, paragraph boundaries, figure references, captions and footer. No grid, OCR, extra crop, SVG or screenshot was opened.
method.rawEvidence: Each of the four original PNG crops was independently opened once and compared with the graphic parts and labels observed on its already-viewed source page. Preservation and absence of adjacent prose, caption and page-number leakage were assessed directly.
method.nativeAuditRole: Frozen audit.json files were read as mechanical corroboration only. Their PASS and row equality are not independent SOURCE proof.
method.printedRows: Rows were independently counted from the page pixels. Each caption sharing a prose row or another caption row contributes no additional unique row; diagram-internal marks are not prose rows.
method.transcriptionConvention: Readable n-shaped normal glyphs, S and N are accepted as conventional Latin transcription with the visible vector arrow represented by LaTeX. Periods, spacing and mathematical wrappers follow the frozen faithful transcription convention. No original digital codepoints are asserted from raster images.
method.blockIndexConvention: pNNNN#K means the 1-based Kth entry of frozen page.json blocks, matching the Kth page.md block header. exactLines and exactText below quote those hash-bound blocks.
method.modernTopologyEvidence: None. SOURCE and RAW PASS do not approve any modern diagram topology, modern labels, FigureSpec, rendered output or product presentation.

exactLines: 通电线圈在磁场中的行为象磁针在磁场中的行为一样.
磁针是条形永久磁铁，其两端分别为$S$极和$N$极. 我们使磁针
能够自由地取向，可以看到通过磁针中心从$S$引到$N$的直线的
方向，与线圈的法线$\vec n$的方向是一致的(图244). 但是，按线圈
中电流的方向用右螺旋法则定出的这个法线方向，是作为表
征磁场的矢量的方向. 因此，**自由稳定下来的磁针从$S$到$N$**
**的方向，可以作为磁感应强度矢量的方向**.
